## Problem and resulting behavior

Describe the concrete issue, expected behavior, and scope of the change. Link the relevant issue or review finding.

## Validation

List the meaningful build/tests executed, results, and operating systems checked. Explain coverage changes and checks that remain pending.

## Compatibility

- [ ] Resource paths, case, formats, and bytes are preserved; the asset verifier passes.
- [ ] A behavioral fix has a reproducing regression test.
- [ ] Binary layouts, game-facing values, and persisted JSON keys are preserved, or an intentional change is supported by independent evidence.
- [ ] New comments and documentation use English; unrelated formatting/encoding changes are avoided.
